contract:
Contract CoCoMEOrderProducts::orderItem(barcode: Integer,quantity: Integer): Boolean {
	precondition:
		self.CurrentOrderProduct.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		Item.allInstances()->exists(i: Item|i.Barcode = barcode)
	postcondition:
		let oldEntries: Set(OrderEntry) = self.CurrentOrderProduct.ContainedEntries@pre,newEntry: OrderEntry,selectedItem: Item = Item.allInstances()->any(candidate: Item|candidate.Barcode = barcode) in
		result = true and
		self.CurrentOrderProduct.ContainedEntries->includesAll(oldEntries) and
		newEntry.oclIsNew() and
		OrderEntry.allInstances()->includes(newEntry) and
		self.CurrentOrderProduct.ContainedEntries->includes(newEntry) and
		newEntry.Item = selectedItem and
		newEntry.Quantity = quantity and
		newEntry.SubAmount = quantity*selectedItem.OrderPrice
}
